title: Used new platform like Lovable for gamedev. it's so fun
author: shottycoin
selftext: Used newly released (Alfa version) platform to create hand controlled (via webcam) ball game. throwing ball to destroy meteors. It's so fun to play actually. I joined their waitlist posted on twitter. It's so fun to play with some crazy game dev experiments.

comments.author: OndrejKurovec
comments.body:
This video is posted on your twitter account where you claim to be the founder of Pixelfork, while here you claim that you randomly found this, "searched it up on google", and "registered for this AI code stuff".  
Here's link btw: [https://x.com/fkhasiyev/status/1950260723323719867](https://x.com/fkhasiyev/status/1950260723323719867)

It's okay to showcase your own projects here, but I don't think you should be acting as a happy customer of your own product.

replies.author: shottycoin
replies.body: Bro, you’re 100% right. Honestly, I sometimes failed at promoting my previous products on Reddit and usually got banned, so I got a bit paranoid and tried to play it safe this time 😅 Now I’m feeling a little guilty haha — but yeah, from now on I’ll be more upfront and transparent. I hope you’d still support what I’m building!

comments.author: shottycoin
comments.body:
**ATTENTION!** I’m Farid, founder of Pixelfork.

I want to sincerely **apologize for not being transparent** in my original post. I was acting like a happy customer using the product — but the truth is, I built it.

I didn’t mean to mislead anyone — I’ve just had rough experiences promoting past projects on Reddit and was honestly a bit afraid of being flagged again. That said, it was the wrong approach, and I’ll be fully open from now on.

**Huge thanks to** [OndrejKurovec](/user/OndrejKurovec/) for calling it out and reminding me to move forward with full transparency.

To make it up, I’d love to offer **100$ worth of credits** to Pixelfork for anyone in this thread. Just DM me and I’ll send over the invite.

Thanks for understanding, and I hope you still find value in what I’m building. 🙏

replies.body: haha cool way to handle this
